statement: The advisor/user explicitly directed 'maybe after 10k then we consider scale to 100k or not, execute'. Approval is limited to the frozen v2 steps-only intervention: restart matched Plain and Compositional arms from the identical seed for 10,000 optimizer steps each, run the independent arms concurrently on two H200 GPUs without DDP or batch changes, evaluate singleton/double development only, and stop. It does not authorize 100,000 steps, held-out-triple access, model/data/hyperparameter changes, sealed/internal access, or official FoundIR test access.
